title: Survey: 70% CTV advertisers to increase spending by 17% in 2026

facts.fact: Per the 2026 CTV/OTT Advertiser Survey by Advertiser Perceptions and Premion, 70% of CTV advertisers expect to increase their CTV spending in 2026.
facts.quote: nearly seven in 10 CTV advertisers (70 per cent) expect to increase their CTV spending, with an average rise of 17 per cent

facts.fact: Per the same Advertiser Perceptions and Premion survey, CTV advertisers expecting to increase spend anticipate an average rise of 17%.
facts.quote: with an average rise of 17 per cent, according t o the _2026 CTV/OTT Advertiser Survey_

facts.fact: Per the survey, 44% of advertisers cite reaching highly engaged, opt-in audiences as a driver of CTV spend increases.
facts.quote: Spend increases are driven by the ability to reach highly engaged, opt-in audiences (44 per cent)

facts.fact: Per the survey, 25% of funding for increased CTV/OTT ad spend in 2026 comes from overall ad budget growth, with the remainder reallocated from other channels.
facts.quote: Among those increasing CTV/OTT ad spend in 2026, 25 per cent of that funding is coming from overall ad budget growth

facts.fact: Per the survey, integrated or hybrid teams control 55% of CTV/Streaming TV budgets.
facts.quote: integrated or hybrid teams now control 55 per cent of CTV/Streaming TV budgets

facts.fact: Per the survey, four in five advertisers agree that combining linear TV and CTV/Streaming TV has a greater impact on brand awareness, reach, ROI and ad recall.
facts.quote: Four in five advertisers agree that combining linear TV and CTV/Streaming TV has a greater impact on increasing brand awareness

facts.fact: Per the survey, 97% of CTV/OTT advertisers agree that advertising on premium video content can improve ROI performance goals.
facts.quote: Ninety-seven percent of CTV/OTT advertisers agree that advertising on premium video content can improve ROI performance goals.

facts.fact: Per the survey, nearly nine in 10 CTV advertisers agree that CTV/Streaming TV increases brand favorability.
facts.quote: Nearly nine in 10 CTV advertisers agree that CTV/Streaming TV increases brand favorability and strengthens positive brand associations.

facts.fact: Per the survey, more than two in five CTV advertisers completely agree that CTV will play a growing role in digital-first buying within total video strategies.
facts.quote: More than two in five CTV advertisers completely agree that CTV will play a growing role in digital-first buying within total video strategies.

facts.fact: Per the survey, nearly nine in 10 advertisers agree that CTV/Streaming TV will continue to grow as a key channel for local and regional advertisers.
facts.quote: Nearly nine in 10 also agree that CTV/Streaming TV will continue to grow as a key channel for local and regional advertisers

facts.fact: The survey expects 50% of CTV/OTT advertising to be purchased programmatically in 2026.
facts.quote: 50 per cent of CTV/OTT advertising is expected to be purchased programmatically in 2026

facts.fact: Per the survey, one-third of advertisers cite challenges related to deduplicated reach, cross-provider planning and walled gardens as fragmentation barriers.
facts.quote: one-third of advertisers citing challenges related to deduplicated reach, cross-provider planning and walled gardens

facts.fact: Per the survey, 58% of advertisers consider real-time optimisation the most valuable AI functionality for CTV/Streaming TV advertising.
facts.quote: real-time optimisation is considered the most valuable AI functionality for CTV/Streaming TV advertising (58 per cent)

facts.fact: Per the survey, 44% of advertisers believe real-time optimisation is likely to be widely available for CTV in 2026.
facts.quote: fewer believe it is likely to be widely available in 2026 (44 per cent)

facts.fact: Per the survey, only one-third of advertisers believe meaningful progress on frequency control is likely in 2026.
facts.quote: yet only one-third believe meaningful progress on frequency control is likely this year
